column1: # Expected bindings rows for the python fixture.
# one per line, byte-sorted. scripts/check.sh asserts this set exactly against
# <out>/bindings.tsv: a missing line is a binding the extractor stopped finding,
# an extra line is one it invented. Both are regressions.
# Written from the fixture sources and the bindings spec alone, by an
# independent oracle that never saw the extractor or its output; the two are
# reconciled separately. `to` is pinned to the edges in EXPECTED.tsv.
# Regenerate deliberately, never reflexively - the point of the file is
# that it does not move when the extractor changes.
# - app/util/winpath.py: the BOM adds no line and the CR of CRLF is not part of any name (module app.models.reading, local Settings).
# - from-import of a submodule gives one row per name, to the submodule file; the package __init__.py edge EXPECTED.tsv also lists for M gets no row.
# - tests/test_export.py:5 from app.util import text: namespace package, submodule lands exactly on app/util/text.py -> module, EXTRACTED.
# - Indented imports (try/except, if TYPE_CHECKING:) are statements: rows included, incl. app/services/report.py:20 jinja2 with empty to.
# - app/services/adapters/csv_adapter.py:24 from ....config climbs above the root: named row _Escaped/Settings, empty to/conf.
# - tests/test_export.py:25-26 importlib.import_module() / __import__() calls are not import statements: no rows.
# - Stdlib from-imports (__future__, typing, dataclasses, datetime, jinja2): M does not resolve, so named rows with empty to.
